FAQ

Questions insurance agents ask

Can insurance agents accept referral commissions?

It depends on your state, your carrier appointments and your agency’s policies. Check with your agency principal or compliance contact before accepting commissions.

What if my client doesn’t qualify?

There’s no cost to your client to explore options. If no product fits, our team tells them clearly. Your relationship stays protected.

Which clients are the best fit?

Commercial clients with steady revenue who are growing: contractors, transportation, restaurants, medical practices and service businesses.

Do I need lending experience?

No. You make the introduction. Our in-house funding team handles the calls, documents, underwriting and closing.

What does it cost to join?

We cover membership options on your demo call, once we understand your network and goals.
